doc.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996

title: Dynamics: less is more
summary: They discuss use of volume and lack of volume in last night's concert.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: I have to comment on a couple of things last night that are an education in themselves, and one of the things is the use of volume and lack of volume.
There was some times there where everybody was just leaning close.
That was the whole idea. Less is more. You learn that when you get the funny colored hair.
